name: ⚔️ Dungeon Lootr
desc:
⚔️ Hack & Slash Dungeon ARPG ⚔️

Plunge into randomly generated dungeons, master over 30+ unique classes, 
and fight your way to the boss and extract with your loot intact.

- 🎲 Spin for devastatingly powerful classes
- ⚔ Enter challenging dungeons for rare loot
- 📝 Experiment with a variety of stat builds
- 🔍 Optimize your builds for the fastest clear times
- 🎁 Play Boss Rush or Challenge Dungeon modes for big challenges
- 🕺💃 Emote & Hangout with friends!

Max Player Level: 225

Premium Plus Players: Earn +5% Player EXP & +10% Class EXP

*Important: Using Bugs / Exploits is strictly prohibited and may result in action(s) being taken.*
